name: Mark as ordered
intro: Ordered this outside Shopify (email, phone, a supplier portal)? Clear Stock counts it as on the way and stops suggesting it. Quantities start at the suggested order.
help: Only for orders not entered in Shopify: Shopify purchase orders and transfers already count as on the way.
nothing: Enter a quantity for at least one variant.

done.one: {{count}} variant marked as ordered. It now counts as on the way.
done.other: {{count}} variants marked as ordered. They now count as on the way.

openOrders: See orders placed in Clear Stock
notSynced: This product isn't in Clear Stock yet. It appears after the next sync.
noForecast: No variant of this product has a forecast to order from yet.

errors.generic: Couldn't save. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Couldn't reach Clear Stock. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid: Check the quantities (whole numbers) and the date.
